user.title: Orange Livebox (Spain)
user.description: Enter the address and administration credentials of your Livebox. By default the password is the WiFi key printed on the router label.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the router, usually 192.168.1.1.
data_description.username: From the local network the web interface always uses `admin`.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate the Livebox
reauth_confirm.description: The router at {host} rejected the stored password. Enter the current one.

discovery_confirm.title: Discovered {model}
discovery_confirm.description: A {model} was found at {host}. Enter its administration credentials to add it. By default the password is the WiFi key printed on the router label.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials, or the router is busy with another administration session (close the router web page and try again).
error.login_locked: The router has temporarily blocked logins after several failed attempts. Wait one minute and try again.
error.unsupported: The device answered but it is not a supported Orange router.

abort.wrong_device: The router at that address is not the one that was configured.
abort.not_supported: The discovered device is not a supported Orange Livebox.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two reads of the router (10–3600).
data_description.track_new_devices: If disabled, new clients are created disabled unless they already belong to another device in Home Assistant.
data_description.session_yield_minutes: The router only allows one administration session. If someone opens the router web page, Home Assistant stops logging in for these minutes so it does not kick them out.

login_locked.message: The router has blocked logins for {seconds} s after several failed attempts.

command_failed.message: The router could not execute the command: {error}

session_in_use.message: Another administration session is using the router (is its web page open?). Home Assistant hands over the session for {minutes} min.

session_yielded.message: Home Assistant is handing over the router session; it will retry in {minutes} min.

command_session_in_use.message: The router rejected the login because another administration session is active. Close the router web page and try again.

feature_not_supported.message: This router model does not support this action.

set_device_name.name: Set device name
set_device_name.description: Changes the name of the device in the router (as in “Customise” in its web interface).

name.name: Name
name.description: New name. The router does not allow ' " \ / & ` $.

set_access_schedule.name: Set internet access schedule
set_access_schedule.description: Parental control: hours in which the device may use the Internet each day. Omitted days are allowed all day; leaving every day out removes the restriction.

monday.name: Monday
monday.description: Allowed hour ranges, end exclusive, e.g. 8-14,16-22. Use - to block the whole day.

tuesday.name: Tuesday
tuesday.description: Allowed hour ranges, end exclusive, e.g. 8-14,16-22. Use - to block the whole day.
